Meet our campaign expertise

THIS IS MAK

A human voice.
A smarter process.
A stronger connection.

Behind every business opportunity is a conversation worth getting right.

MAK BPO And Telecommunications is a call centre in Satellite Town, Rawalpindi, specialising in insurance campaign support for the U.S. market. Our Pakistan night shift runs from 6:00 PM to 5:00 AM the following morning — connecting campaign conversations, closers, and validators.
